features.it: Espanso il catalogo scansionato a tutti gli archetipi (marketing, social media, creator, web studio, medico, famiglia/casalinga, tecnico sul campo). Aggiunti strumenti per Telegram, SMS, domotica Home Assistant, comparazione prezzi NVR, aggiunta carrello Amazon e diagnostica hardware.
features.en: Expanded scanned catalog across all archetypes (marketing, social media, creator, web studio, doctor, family/home, field technician). Added tools for Telegram, SMS, Home Assistant domotica, NVR price comparison, Amazon cart actions, and hardware diagnostics.
features.fr: Expansion du catalogue scanné à tous les archétypes (marketing, réseaux sociaux, créateur, studio web, médecin, famille/maison, technicien). Ajout d'outils pour Telegram, SMS, domotique Home Assistant, comparaison de prix NVR, actions panier Amazon et diagnostic matériel.
features.es: Ampliación del catálogo escaneado a todos los arquetipos (marketing, redes sociales, creador, estudio web, médico, familia/hogar, técnico). Añadidas herramientas para Telegram, SMS, domótica Home Assistant, comparación de precios NVR, acciones de carrito Amazon y diagnóstico de hardware.
